space.$description: Theme-independent spacing semantics. These names describe the *role* a gap plays, so a component can ask for 'the inline padding of a control' without knowing which step of the scale that currently is.

controlInline.$description: Inline (left/right) padding inside an interactive control at the default size.

controlBlock.$description: Block (top/bottom) padding inside an interactive control at the default size.

controlGap.$description: Gap between a control's own parts, e.g. between a button's icon and its label.

buttonInlineCompactXSmall.$description: 4px compact inline padding for xsmall buttons.

buttonInlineCompactSmall.$description: 6px compact inline padding for small buttons.

buttonInlineCompactMedium.$description: 8px compact inline padding for medium buttons.

buttonInlineCompactLarge.$description: 8px compact inline padding for large buttons.

switchInset.$description: 2px inset between a switch thumb and track.

bubbleInline.$description: 12px inline padding for regular bubble content.

bubbleBlock.$description: 8px block padding for regular bubble content.

bubbleGap.$description: 4px gap between a bubble surface and its anchored reaction region.

bubbleGroupGap.$description: 8px gap between consecutive bubbles in one speaker group.

bubbleReactionInline.$description: 6px inline padding for non-action bubble reactions.

bubbleReactionBlock.$description: 2px block padding for non-action bubble reactions.

bubbleReactionInset.$description: 12px inline inset for a bubble reaction pill.

bubbleReactionOffset.$description: 20px outside offset for top or bottom bubble reactions.

menuShell.$description: 4px inset around a popup menu item stack.

menuGap.$description: 2px vertical gap between popup menu rows.

menuInline.$description: 8px inline padding inside a popup menu row.

menuChromeInline.$description: 8px inline padding for persistent popup menu header and footer chrome.

menuChromeBlock.$description: 6px block padding for persistent popup menu header and footer chrome.

containerInline.$description: Inline padding inside a surface container such as a card.

containerBlock.$description: Block padding inside a surface container such as a card.

containerGap.$description: Gap between sibling regions inside a container, e.g. a card's header and its content.

stack.$description: Default vertical rhythm between stacked blocks.

inline.$description: Default horizontal gap between inline siblings.

groupRelated.$description: Tight spacing between parts that form one semantic value or control.

groupInline.$description: Default spacing between sibling nodes grouped on the inline axis.

groupBlock.$description: Block-axis spacing between related controls or content groups.

region.$description: Separation between distinct regions in a larger Web surface.
